Earth Day Seasonal Salad

Served at: Earth Day

Serves 4-6Prep 20 min

This vibrant Earth Day Seasonal Salad celebrates the bounty of spring and the importance of fresh, local ingredients. It's a light, refreshing, and colorful dish perfect for a springtime meal, embodying the spirit of sustainability and appreciation for our planet's natural gifts.

Ingredients

  • 8 ounces (225 g) mixed spring greens or baby spinach
  • 1 medium cucumber, thinly sliced
  • 4-6 radishes, thinly sliced
  • 1 pint (about 2 cups / 300 g) cherry tomatoes, halved
  • 1 small bell pepper (any color), thinly sliced
  • 1 cup (150 g) fresh strawberries, hulled and sliced
  • 1/2 cup (60 g) crumbled feta cheese (optional)
  • 1/4 cup (30 g) toasted walnuts or pecans
  • For the Dressing:
  • 1/4 cup (60 mL) extra virgin olive oil
  • 2 tablespoons (30 mL) apple cider vinegar
  • 1 teaspoon (5 mL) Dijon mustard
  • 1 teaspoon (5 mL) maple syrup or honey (optional)
  • 1/4 teaspoon (1.25 g) salt
  • 1/8 teaspoon (0.6 g) black pepper

Method

  1. In a large salad bowl, combine the mixed greens, sliced cucumber, sliced radishes, halved cherry tomatoes, sliced bell pepper, and sliced strawberries.
  2. If using, sprinkle the crumbled feta cheese and toasted walnuts or pecans over the vegetables and fruit.
  3. In a small bowl or jar, whisk together the extra virgin olive oil, apple cider vinegar, Dijon mustard, maple syrup or honey (if using), salt, and black pepper until well combined.
  4. Just before serving, pour the dressing over the salad.
  5. Toss gently to coat all ingredients evenly.
  6. Serve immediately and enjoy the fresh flavors.

Tips

  • To truly honor Earth Day, choose organic and locally sourced ingredients whenever possible.
  • For a more substantial meal, add grilled chicken, chickpeas, or hard-boiled eggs.
  • Prepare the salad components and dressing separately, then combine just before serving to prevent the greens from becoming soggy.
